blocks.content: The last step is to confirm that notifications actually reach your contact point when the alert fires.
To verify notifications, complete the following steps:

To trigger a test notification, temporarily lower the alert threshold to a value your data currently exceeds.

For example, if your CPU usage is normally around 40%, set the threshold to "is above 10" so the alert fires.
Wait for the evaluation interval plus the pending period to pass. Then check your notification destination (email inbox, Slack channel, etc.) for the alert notification.
After confirming the notification arrived, **restore your original threshold** so the alert monitors the condition you actually care about.
Notifications are working. Your alert rule is fully configured, saved, verified, and delivering notifications.
